Bitcoin Archive's hard numbers format (exact dollar inflows, BTC holdings) sets engagement baseline.
protocol_pulse_voice_guidance: Lean into Admiral-testimony-as-legitimacy-inflection-point without losing cypherpunk edge. Frame institutional adoption as checkmate against fiat denial, not capitulation to legacy. Use exact numbers (Morgan Stanley $256M, MicroStrategy $3.6B, 139M BTC holdings) as ammunition against 'still early' discourse — but weaponize them to argue whales ARE early, retail is late.
